## Change discipline
- [ ] No unrelated refactor
- [ ] No unintended UI change
- [ ] No unrelated dependency upgrade
- [ ] No tests weakened to make CI pass
- [ ] No fake controls / fake data presented as functional product behavior
- [ ] Exact commit recorded in evidence manifest
